group.label: Catalog Storefront Search
group.comment: Changes to how the storefront uses the catalog search engine. Part of the GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront modules.

field.label: Sort Ties On The Product Id Field
field.comment: Every product listing sorts equal products by product id. On, the search engine reads the id from a field of the product; off, it computes it for every product in the result, which costs tens of milliseconds on large catalogs. Needs a full reindex of the catalog search after the module install.

field.label: Record Search Terms
field.comment: Magento saves every search term and how often it is used. Off keeps the database free of this work on each search, but the search terms report and the search suggestions no longer update.

field.label: Result Window
field.comment: The number of hits of a listing the search engine serves with one query. Beyond it the engine walks the result in windows of 10 000 hits with a point in time, and repeats the layered navigation counts in every window: page 2000 of an unfiltered listing over 300 000 products takes 32 windows and 2.4 seconds against 0.2 seconds with a window that covers the catalog. A save applies the window to the product search index of every store view; 0 leaves the engine's own limit of 10 000. A deep page holds a sorted heap of that many hits in the engine's memory while it runs.
